title: Automated Transfer of Inactivated Virus Samples to 96-Well Plate
author: Efthymios Fidanis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfb2jiqe
materials: Unscrew 2 ml tubes containing sample and discard lid. Place open 2 ml tubes in Hamilton rack (Cat no. SMP_CAR_32_A00 with blue 2 ml tube inserts) with barcode facing forward as shown below: The method has been installed on both our Hamilton STAR and STARlet instruments but this protocol only descibes the procedure on the STAR.
Scan barcode into label printer to make an additional identical barcode for archiving box. Place in plate carrier (Cat no. PLT_CAR_L5MD_A00) in track position 49-54 on Hamilton robot.
Follow guide using tip carrier with a tip rack in all 5 positions (can be empty, full or part used. Carrier cat no. TIP_CAR_480_AOO). Tip carrier placed in track positions 37-42.

Either: Cover plate and handling very carefully, pass plate immediately to RNA extraction team to be placed on BioMek Fx. Or: If plate is not to be used immediately, add plastic seal (cat no. AB-0558 located on bench next to Hamilton robot) and store 96-well Nunc plate at Room temperature in clear box labelled “to be extracted” (located on bench along from Hamilton robot) in ASF until extraction robot is available.

steps.title: Prepare incoming sample tubes
steps.instruction: In the reception area, wipe the outside of each tube with an alcohol wipe, invert the tube twice, place it in a centrifuge and perform a pulse spin.

steps.title: Re‑box and transport tubes
steps.instruction: Remove the spun tubes, place them into a new 10 × 10 box, and transport the box to the automation laboratory.

steps.title: Load rack into robot
steps.instruction: Insert the rack into robot track position 45‑47 (rack 1 → 45, rack 2 → 46, rack 3 → 47) according to the number of samples; align tube barcodes so they are visible in the inserts window. If processing 93 samples, leave rack 3 positions 30, 31 and 32 empty for later controls.

steps.title: Label 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Affix an LPL barcode label to the lower right‑hand edge of a 96‑well Nunc plate (1.3 mL, catalog no. 260251).

steps.title: Start Hamilton transfer protocol
steps.instruction: On the Hamilton desktop, press the ‘H’ button, open the sample‑transfer protocol, answer ‘yes’ to the loading‑help pop‑up, verify the robot cover is closed, then press OK to begin the run that will transfer 200 µL of inactivated virus solution into the designated wells of the barcoded plate.

steps.title: Remove plate after run
steps.instruction: When the program finishes and the carriers return to their initial positions, remove the 96‑well plate and visually confirm the transferred volume (easiest view from below).

steps.title: Validate transfer log
steps.instruction: Open the generated .csv file, confirm that all error counts are zero, report any error codes to technical support, and upload the .csv to the sample‑tracking application.

steps.title: Cap residual tube
steps.instruction: Take the 2 mL tube that contains residual sample from the Hamilton rack and cap it with a new coloured lid (located on the bench in front of the Hamilton and labelled accordingly).

steps.title: Enter barcode for archiving
steps.instruction: In the consolidation app, input the tube barcode, then attach the same barcode label to the box that will be used for archiving the samples (the app is also used later for archiving RNA samples after extraction).

steps.title: Update LIMS dashboard
steps.instruction: When the barcode entry is completed in Clarity LIMS, a database table is updated and a dashboard entry appears indicating the samples are ready for archiving.

steps.title: Enter storage information
steps.instruction: Open the archiving app, view the pending boxes and plates, and enter the required storage details for each item.

steps.title: Confirm archiving record
steps.instruction: After logging the storage information, the record disappears from the archiving screen and the information becomes visible in the archive‑search application.

steps.title: Store samples at –80 °C
steps.instruction: Place the archived samples into the freezer box labeled with the barcode from step 9 and store the box at –80 °C.
